rules.statement: A Crown grant in Ceylon confers absolute dominion on the purchaser, superseding all other title existing at the date of the grant unless such title has been derived from the Crown itself. The remedy for any person claiming to have had better title than the Crown is an action for damages against the Crown.
rules.supporting_quote: "I find that the law in Ceylon is that a Crown grant confers the absolute dominium on the purchaser, superseding all other title existing at the date of the grant, unless such title has been derived from the Crown itself, and that the remedy for any person claiming to have had, at the date of the grant, better title than the Crown, is an action for damages against the Crown"
